```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)
library(Rcpp)
Sys.setenv(PKG_CXXFLAGS = glue("-I{getwd()}/../usr/include -I/opt/homebrew/include"))
Sys.setenv(PKG_LIBS = glue("-L{getwd()}/../usr/lib -L/opt/homebrew/lib -lccnc_lib -lmosquitto"))
sourceCpp("interface.cpp", rebuild = FALSE)
```

# Testing the CNCpp library

Create a program object:

```{r}
cnc <- new(CNCpp, "../machine.ini")
cnc$version()
```

Load a program:
```{r}
cnc$load("../test.gcode")
cnc$print()
cnc$reset()
```

Run the simulation and plot:

```{r}
df <- cnc$simulate()
```


```{r}
df %>% 
  mutate(kind=cut(acc, c(-Inf, -1e-6, 1e-6, Inf), labels=c("acc", "cruise", "dec"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=t_time, y=lambda)) + 
  geom_line(linewidth=0.2) +
  geom_point(aes(color=kind), size=0.1) +
  labs(x="Total time (s)")
```


```{r}
df %>%
  mutate(type=as.factor(type)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=x, y=y, color=speed)) +
  geom_path(aes(linewidth=speed)) +
  scale_color_viridis_b() +
  coord_equal()
```
